profile_text.body:
Accenture plc describes itself as a company that embraces change to create 360-degree value and shared success for clients, people, shareholders, partners, and communities. Its website says it works across industries and around the world to create better experiences using emerging technologies and human ingenuity, with the stated aim that "together, we can reinvent anything." The site discusses redesigning work, accelerating skills, and reinventing HR so people and AI work together in what it calls the Human + AI era.

The website does not name specific AI products. It presents AI-related themes including a claimed gap between executive confidence and scale after two years of AI acceleration, power demand from AI exceeding grid limits, a power-first strategy for data center developers, and cyber resilience as a strategic mandate in an AI-driven threat landscape. It also states that Accenture is helping the European Commission's Directorate-General for International Partnerships to scale AI across global operations.

Accenture plc is a for-profit public company headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, trading under the ticker ACN. Its SEC registrant CIK is 0001467373, and it is also listed under the name ACCENTURE PLC-CL A. The available facts do not list any products, lawsuits, or MCP servers for the company.
